This writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned F.I.R. dated 04.11. 2022 lodged by the respondent no. 4 against the petitioner in Case Crime No. 245 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323 376, & 511 of I.P.c. and Section 3/4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act,
2019 and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District- Saharanpur.
(B) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent no.2 and 3 not to arrest the petitioner in Case Crime No. 245 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323 376, & 511 of I.P.c. and Section 3/4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 and Section 3/4 of D.P. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Present petition is accordingly dismissed for want of prosecution.
